notes_for_editor: Only two sources. Build date, design, height, staffing, access and any fate after the 2006 sale are not in any source we read; the story says so only where it matters for a visitor. The sale required removal within 30 days, but no source confirms removal. The brief's register 'GFC US 717' appears to be a Georgia Forestry Commission cross-reference; NHLR US 717 is the Seminole County Fire Tower (GA 12), so do not read it as an NHLR number. The Savannah Morning News 2006 fire-tower article may cover this sale but was unreadable (403 via fetch_text, refused by WebFetch). Story is 110 words, short of the 120 guideline, because evidence is thin.
